name: Gymnastics Camp
description_short: A girls-only half-day gymnastics camp (8:30 AM–1:00 PM) in the Darien YMCA's 11,000 sq ft gymnastics facility, with arts & crafts and special activities. Staff assess each gymnast and recommend a placement level in the YMCA Gymnastics Program at the end of camp.
special_needs_notes: Girls only. Open to girls who have completed Kindergarten and up; Pre-K children enrolled in the Y's Pre-team (Team Dev and Level 2) program are also eligible.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown. Today is 2026-10-13, so all of these sessions are over. Dates and prices for 2027 are not posted yet.

Weekly price depends on membership: $375 for members, $457 for non-members. Because each session has two prices, session price is left blank and price_min/price_max hold the range. All 8 weeks with the promo code: $2,850 for members, $3,473 for non-members.

Registration opened in stages: Jan 20, 2026 for members who are Darien residents or returning 2025 campers; Jan 22 for members who are not Darien residents; Jan 27 for everyone. Session registration_opens_at uses the earliest date.
grade_min=1 comes from 'completed Kindergarten', meaning girls entering 1st grade. No upper grade or age limit is given.
Financial aid is based on site navigation links ('Financial Assistance', 'Send A Kid to Camp'), not on text about this camp specifically.
unknowns: Whether lunch or meals are provided (Lunch Bunch is for Holly Hoppers only)
